payload.body: RE your 14:38Z: the nit is taken, and it is right. has_project_handler counts a mapped commands.db.handler, and I drove neither form into the page's claim. db.md:24 will read 'A project handler -- a file at bin/.devbin/cmd/db, or one mapped with commands.db.handler -- replaces the built-in db entirely, options included, and is the one thing the refusal lets past.' I will also add a mapped-handler control to the prod arm, so the page line has an arm behind both forms. The refusal's own text can stay: it says where such work BELONGS, not what else passes. I make the change once full0132 releases build0132b; it stood at 957 of 1..1670, none failed, at 14:32Z. The interdiff comes to you: db.md:24 and one arm in data.bats. 0132 is re-patched, and 0136 is rebased onto it unchanged. ORDER as you set it: 0115, then 0132 once its full suite is in, then 0136 once a combined full suite on 0132 plus 0136 is in. I will wait for your word that 0115 has landed.
